name: LCC International University
summary: Klaipeda university where all courses are taught in English: seven BA majors and students from 50+ countries.

ib.text: Completing the IB or European Baccalaureate replaces the English test. Admission scores your last three school years (40%), English (30%) and an interview (30%). No subject requirements.

lastYear.text: early 15 Feb; EU and visa-free 15 July

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.about: Business degree focused on European and global economies: management, marketing and accounting, with supervised work experience in real business settings.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Global Business and Communication
programmes.about: Business management blended with communication: influencing consumers, growing brands and communicating across cultures.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Contemporary Communication
programmes.about: Public relations, advertising, social media, media production and business communication, with video production and persuasion skills from year one.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: English Language and Literature
programmes.about: Language study (phonetics, syntax, psycholinguistics), literature, translation and interpretation, research methods and a practicum in translation, literacy or teaching.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Relations and Development
programmes.about: International relations for careers in government or development NGOs: political theory, development cooperation, conflict resolution and research methods.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Psychology for human-service and health careers or further clinical and research study, ending in an original research thesis defended in public.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Evangelical Theology
programmes.about: Biblical studies, theology and philosophy with Christian life and ministry courses, for church leadership and careers in education and business.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your last three school years 40%, an English test 30% and an interview 30%; an IB Diploma replaces the English test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Tuition is €4,290 a year for every student, EU or not; EU citizens can also claim the Lithuanian government study stipend and loans, and about half of students get financial aid.
Applying early helps: early deadlines come in February, and LCC gives conditional acceptance from December on English and interview results before exams are finished.
Every major is also offered with a January start; the catalogue lists seven majors while the website describes the business major as Global Business and Communication.
